definitions.explanation: Wine made from green or yellow grapes, or from dark grapes with the skins removed. A common beverage in restaurants and at home.

examples.japanese: {魚料理|さかなりょうり}には{白|しろ}ワインが{合|あ}う。
examples.english: White wine goes well with fish dishes.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}やした{白|しろ}ワインを{一杯|いっぱい}{飲|の}みながら{夕日|ゆうひ}を{眺|なが}めた。
examples.english: I watched the sunset while drinking a glass of chilled white wine.

notes:
USAGE:
The Japanese term uses {白|しろ} (white) + ワイン (wine). In contrast, red wine is {赤|あか}ワイン and rosé is ロゼワイン. When ordering at a restaurant, simply {白|しろ} can be used as shorthand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白|しろ}ワインを{注文|ちゅうもん}する (to order white wine)
- {辛口|からくち}の{白|しろ}ワイン (dry white wine)
- {甘口|あまくち}の{白|しろ}ワイン (sweet white wine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤|あか}ワイン: red wine
- ロゼワイン: rosé wine
